work: STEP 10.4 — G7 real-chain status AFTER the P1 text-safety remediation
headline: The P1 is remediated on the real runtime: 10/10 real Groq model actions accepted, 0 person_name rejections across 3 real Chrome runs. G7 is NOT closed — the chain now dies further along, for two unrelated reasons.

p1Proof.labels: PROVEN_REAL (live FastAPI :8010, real Groq openai/gpt-oss-20b, production extension dist/, real Chrome 153.0.8010.12)

directBackendProbes.afterRemediation: HTTP 200 x3, success=true, real action {action: click, target: btn-shop-now}

realChromeRuns.firstReasonAccepted: Click the 'Shop Now' button to open the store catalog listing.
Click the 'Shop Now' button to open the store catalog listing page.

g7Chain.detail: declaredDestination={provenance:USER_DECLARED_DESTINATION, role:[LISTING]}, destinationUrl null, present in every request body (5/5 and 7/7)
completedSteps: ['click: Click element btn-shop-now'], lastActionResult.success true
observed pageType=UNKNOWN confidence=0.10 — CORRECT: /search.html is an empty search form with no listing content. The agent navigated to the search page, not the results page.
loop advanced to step 3 (run 1) / step 4 (run 2) and issued further real actions, but never past the destination subgoal

blockers.exact: HTTP 503 {"reason":"Reasoning unavailable: groq (rate_limit) and fallback openrouter (http_client_error) failed.","error_kind":"http_client_error","retryable":false}
blockers.detail: The Groq free tier allows ~3 requests/minute. The agent loop issues TWO provider calls per step (a STRONG reasoner call and a SAFETY review call), so the loop exhausts the budget by step 2-3 and then fails closed. The configured fallback provider has no working credential.
blockers.when: terminal failure in both real runs
blockers.note: This is a DIFFERENT blocker from Step 10.3. The Step 10.3 blocker was rule=person_name from text_safety. This one is upstream of text_safety entirely and is environmental.

blockers.class: task / navigation choice (NOT a verifier defect)
blockers.exact: The model clicks 'Shop Now', which lands on /search.html, then reasons 'No catalog or listing link is visible on the current search page' and scrolls.
blockers.detail: /search.html is an empty search FORM. It classifies SEARCH/UNKNOWN, not LISTING. The real LISTING page is /results.html (4 product-card elements). The agent never navigates there, so the DestinationVerifier correctly never returns MATCH. The verifier behaved correctly at every step; it simply was never given a listing page.
blockers.note: Recorded, NOT fixed. Routing the agent from /search.html to /results.html would mean changing the prompt, the fixture, or the planner — all outside Step 10.4's scope, and none of them is a text-safety concern.

blockers.exact: scroll -> ACTION_NO_EFFECT 'Scroll down produced zero viewport movement (scrollDelta: 0px). Viewport likely hit scroll boundary.'
blockers.detail: The empty search form has nothing below the fold, so the scroll produced no movement and effect verification failed closed. This is the M10 observer working as designed.

negativeControls.alreadyAtDestination: requires the verifier (G1 semantics preserved) — tests/step10_3_roleOnlyControls.test.ts
negativeControls.actionNoEffect: remains action failure, not destination success — observed PROVEN_REAL in both runs

honesty: The P1 is closed and that is proven on the real runtime. G7 is NOT closed: a successful HTTP response is not G7 proof, and the chain never reached a LISTING observation, a verifier MATCH, a subgoal completion or the GoalVerifier. No text-safety rule was weakened to try to get there, and the residual false negatives this step found in the pre-existing rule (ASCII-only shape, lower-case names) were recorded rather than silently widened.
